allow: PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $jar = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.m2\\repository\\org\\springdoc\\springdoc-openapi-starter-common\\3.0.0\\springdoc-openapi-starter-common-3.0.0.jar"; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\($jar\); $entry = $zip.GetEntry\("org/springdoc/core/configuration/SpringDocHateoasConfiguration.class"\); $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream; $entry.Open\(\).CopyTo\($ms\); $zip.Dispose\(\); $bytes = $ms.ToArray\(\); $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder; $run = 0; $start = 0; for \($i = 0; $i -lt $bytes.Length; $i++\) { $b = $bytes[$i]; if \($b -ge 32 -and $b -le 126\) { if \($run -eq 0\) { $start = $i }; $run++ } else { if \($run -ge 8\) { $s = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString\($bytes, $start, $run\); $null = $sb.AppendLine\($s\) }; $run = 0 } }; $sb.ToString\(\) -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match "enable|[Pp]ropert|[Cc]ondition|hateoas|Hateoas|spring\\." })

PowerShell($ui = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8081/swagger-ui.html" -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); Write-Host "swagger-ui.html -> $\($ui.StatusCode\)"; $docs = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8081/api-docs" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); Write-Host "api-docs -> $\($docs.StatusCode\)"; $v3 = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8081/v3/api-docs" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); Write-Host "v3/api-docs -> $\($v3.StatusCode\)")
